name: Application for benefit
description: Guidelines and procedures for processing applications for benefit, including rules around application forms, date of first contact, supporting evidence requirements, IRD number requirements, and investigation of applications.

attributes.summary: Covers the end-to-end process for applying for a benefit, including form usage, lapse rules, date of first contact, extensions, good and sufficient reason, investigating applications, IRD number rules, and supporting evidence.
steps: Application form can be used for more than one type of assistance
Application form may not be required
IRD number not required in certain circumstances
Non-tax resident partner's IRD number not required
Notice to provide IRD number evidence
